articles.text: 学生B: 浅草へ行きたいんですが、切符売場はどこですか。 (Gakusei B: Asakusa e ikitain desu ga, kippu uriba wa doko desu ka?)
STUDENT B: (translating Student A's request) I want to go to Asakusa, where is the ticket window?
教師: 切符売場ですか。その自動販売機ですよ。 (Kyoushi: Kippu uriba desu ka? Sono jidoo hanbaiki desu yo.)
INSTRUCTOR: The ticket window? It's that vending machine.
学生B: (to Student A) The ticket window is that vending machine.
STUDENT B: It's that vending machine.
学生B: 虎ノ門へ行きたいんですが、いくらですか。 (Gakusei B: Toranomon e ikitain desu ga, ikura desu ka?)
STUDENT B: (translating) I want to go to Toranomon, how much is it?
教師: 虎ノ門ですか。二百円です。 (Kyoushi: Toranomon desu ka? Ni-hyaku-en desu.)
INSTRUCTOR: Toranomon? It's 200 yen.
学生B: (to Student A) It's 200 yen.
STUDENT B: It's 200 yen.
学生B: 日比谷へ行きたいんですが、ここで切符が買えますか。 (Gakusei B: Hibiya e ikitain desu ga, koko de kippu ga kaemasu ka?)
STUDENT B: (translating) I want to go to Hibiya, can I buy a ticket here?
教師: そこの自動販売機で買ってください。百八十円です。 (Kyoushi: Soko no jidoo hanbaiki de katte kudasai. Hyaku hachi-juu-en desu.)
INSTRUCTOR: Please buy it at that vending machine. It's 180 yen.
学生B: (to Student A) Please buy it at that vending machine — it's 180 yen.
STUDENT B: Buy it at the vending machine; it's 180 yen.
学生B: 三越前へ行きたいんですが、切符を買ってくださいませんか。いくらですか。 (Gakusei B: Mitsukoshi-mae e ikitain desu ga, kippu o katte kudasaimasen ka? Ikura desu ka?)
STUDENT B: (translating) I want to go to Mitsukoshi Mae station, would you buy a ticket for me? How much is it?
教師: ええ、いいですよ。(学生がいくらか聞いたあとで) 二百三十円ですよ。(切符を買ってから) はい、これが切符です。 (Kyoushi: Ee, ii desu yo. (Gakusei ga ikura ka kiita ato de) Ni-hyaku san-juu-en desu yo. (Kippu o katte kara) Hai, kore ga kippu desu.)
INSTRUCTOR: Sure, alright. (After the student asks how much) It's 230 yen. (After buying the ticket) Here, this is the ticket.
学生B: (to Student A) Sure. It's 230 yen. Here's the ticket.
STUDENT B: It's 230 yen. Here's the ticket.
学生B: 日本橋へ行きたいんですが、いくらですか。 (Gakusei B: Nihonbashi e ikitain desu ga, ikura desu ka?)
STUDENT B: (translating) I want to go to Nihonbashi, how much is it?
教師: さあ、私も知りませんが、ああ、上に表がありますね。ええと、二百八十円です。 (Kyoushi: Saa, watashi mo shirimasen ga, aa, ue ni hyoo ga arimasu ne. Eeto, ni-hyaku hachi-juu-en desu.)
INSTRUCTOR: Well, I don't know either, but oh, there's a chart up there. Let me see, it's 280 yen.
学生B: (to Student A) The chart shows it's 280 yen.
STUDENT B: It's 280 yen.
学生B: 赤坂見附へ行きたいんですが、切符はどこで買えますか。 (Gakusei B: Akasakamitsuke e ikitain desu ga, kippu wa doko de kaemasu ka?)
STUDENT B: (translating) I want to go to Akasakamitsuke, where can I buy a ticket?
教師: 赤坂見附ですね。あっちの方です。連れて行ってあげましょう。 (Kyoushi: Akasakamitsuke desu ne. Atchi no hoo desu. Tsurete itte agemashoo.)
INSTRUCTOR: Akasakamitsuke, right? It's over that way. I'll take you there.
学生B: (to Student A) It's over that way. He/she will take us there.
STUDENT B: He'll take us there.
